name: Biga Ogi Sijaghaessjiman, Nag-yeob-eun Imi Jeoj-eoiss-eossda
original_name: 비가 오기 시작했지만, 낙엽은 이미 젖어있었다
source:
Memories and regrets that exist in your school days. And "Growth"

How was your school days? "Beginning of the Rain" tells you a lot of different stories that take place in a lot of efforts to make your youth more beautiful.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
留存在学生时代里的回忆与遗憾，以及“成长”。

你的学生时代是怎样度过的呢？《Beginning of the Rain》讲述了一段段形形色色的青春故事——那是人们为了让自己青春岁月更加绚烂美好而倾注无数努力的点滴篇章。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2400700/]Steam[/url]]
